ModMetaData.name: Android tiers
ModMetaData.author: Atlas, aRandomKiwi, CrackaJack, MushuIV
ModMetaData.description:
- Adds 5 tiers of autonomous mechanical colonists along with cybernetic animals - Full integrated TX Series infiltration androids (TX2, TX2K, TX3, TX4 and infantry variants) with living synthetic flesh, human disguise, and EMP/solar flare immunity - 2 autonomous android factions (Civil Android Collective and Android Insurrection) - Remote control surrogate android avatars via SkyMind network - Digitize, upload, duplicate, and store colonist minds in centralized supercomputers - Mechanical-specific ailments, maintenance faults, and coolant failures - Deep cybernetic upgrade tree (replacement organs, specialized processors, nanite frameworks) - Full expansion compatibility: vacuum/orbital-sealed for Odyssey, toxic/pollution immune for Biotech, mind-isolated from Anomaly flesh parasites
Optional Integrations: - Questionable Ethics Enhanced (QEE): Enables vat-growing TX Series infiltration chassis using donor human genomes. - Enable Oversized Weapons: Enhanced rendering for M7/M8 mechanized heavy armaments.
Version <color=#FFD800>3.0.0 (RW 1.7)</color>
